title: First box worth it, not continuing
text: With the discount on your first box it's not too bad of a deal seems very expensive once you're paying full price. It also seems that you get the same things in each box which is kind of a bummer. They don't seem to have any system in place where you could customize a box or change something out. For example I got the medium dog box but my dog does not like the cheese and bacon filled bones or the meaty beef bones, but would love the pig snout and bully sticks spring. It actually seems like it goes more based on what the treats are than the size of the dog because my 25 lb dog would have done better with the large dog box. I do wish I thought there would be more variety moving forward and that they would maybe have some younique products or something that made it worth getting the box versus buying the items individually but $40 a month for what we got today is definitely way too much so we're going to be canceling. She did love the pig ear, though ❤️🐷
